content: S. C. was the author of the book Breaking the Vicious Cycle: Intestinal Health Through Diet. She wrote this book to provide a novel dietary approach for individuals suffering from intestinal bowel disorders. The approach she advocated is known as the Specific Carbohydrate Diet (SCD). Numerous testimonials exist from individuals who were on the verge of undergoing colectomy (surgical removal of the colon) but were able to manage their symptoms effectively through dietary changes, ultimately regaining normal functionality. In her later years, she developed a keen interest in exploring the potential benefits of the Specific Carbohydrate Diet for children with developmental disorders, including autism. She dedicated significant amounts of her time to assisting parents, both through online message boards and in-person interactions, offering guidance and support. Her work was built upon the foundational research and contributions of Dr. [name not provided].
